svg.title: Bubble-point trial at 40 °C: K at p ≈ 405 kPa
svg.text: Bubble-point trial at 40 °C: K at p ≈ 405 kPa
High-temperature DePriester chart (nomograph), redrawn from Wankat Eq. 2-30 / Table 2-3
Mark a trial pressure on the left scale (converged trial: p ≈ 405 kPa).
Mark T = 40 °C on the temperature scale (right).
Join them with a straight edge (dashed: earlier trials at 300 and 500 kPa).
Read K: ethane 8.57, n-C₅ 0.333, n-C₇ 0.047, so ΣKx = 1.000 → bubble point.
Redrawn from the correlation; in the exam read the printed chart — values may differ slightly.
